intro: Suzetta Gallina is a member of the Gallina family, purveyors of fine vintages in Stormwind City. She can be found inside the family's wine shop tucked along the Canals, helping manage the business and spread word of their stock to thirsty patrons across the city.

p: Situated along the scenic waterways of Stormwind's Canal District, the Gallina Winery caters to citizens seeking quality vintages imported or crafted across the kingdom. Suzetta Gallina helps oversee daily life in the establishment, maintaining the family legacy of supplying taverns, nobles, and common folk with wine. While not a public figure of high politics, her presence represents the everyday commercial heartbeat that keeps the capital thriving amidst broader troubles.
